trial_court: Senior Civil Judge & Principal JMFC, Tarikeere, MC No.12/2013
case_name: S P Rekha vs K M Santhosh
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 14.12.2008. Appellant gave birth to a son on 16.09.2009. Parties started residing together but had differences and appellant went to her parents' home. Respondent filed petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: A petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty should contain specific instances of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled in law that a petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty should contain specific instances of cruelty (See: NEELAM KUMAR VS. DAYA RANI.).

legal_principles.principle: Desertion means the intentional abandonment of the spouse by the other without the consent of the other and without a reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: A Five Judge Bench of the Supreme Court in LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA which has been followed in DEBANANDA TAMULI Vs. KAKUMONI KATAKY, while dealing with the expression 'desertion', has held that desertion means the intentional abandonment of the spouse by the other without the consent of the other and without a reasonable cause.
cited_cases: LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA

outcome.final_order: Petition filed by respondent seeking dissolution of marriage on ground of cruelty and desertion was allowed.
